name: Thales
title: Founder of the Milesian school
note: Water is the origin of all things. Regarded as the first philosopher

name: Pythagoras
title: Mathematician and religious teacher
note: Pythagorean theorem. "All is number"

name: Heraclitus
title: Natural philosopher
note: "All things flow". Fire as the origin

name: Socrates
title: Philosopher (no office)
note: Socratic method. Executed by hemlock. Wrote nothing

name: Democritus
title: Natural philosopher
note: All things are made of atoms

name: Plato
title: Founder of the Academy
note: Theory of Forms. Founded the Academy

name: Aristotle
title: Founder of the Lyceum
note: Master of all knowledge. Tutor of Alexander the Great

name: Alexander the Great
title: King of Macedon, the Great
note: Built a world empire. Student of Aristotle

name: Epicurus
title: Philosopher
note: Hedonism. "Death is nothing to us"

name: Zeno
title: Philosopher
note: Founded Stoicism. Taught in Athens

name: Seneca
title: Adviser to Nero, philosopher
note: Stoic philosophy. Executed by Nero

name: Marcus Aurelius
title: Roman emperor
note: Philosopher emperor. "Be yourself"

name: Augustine
title: Bishop of Hippo
note: Greatest Father of the Western Church. Doctrine of grace

name: Albertus Magnus
title: Theologian and scholar
note: Teacher of Thomas Aquinas. "Doctor Universalis"

name: Thomas Aquinas
title: Theologian
note: Perfected Scholasticism. Harmony of faith and reason

name: Machiavelli
title: Florentine diplomat
note: The Prince. Father of realist politics. Italy

name: Thomas More
title: Lord Chancellor (England)
note: Utopia. Executed by Henry VIII

name: Francis Bacon
title: Lord Chancellor (England)
note: Father of empiricism. "Knowledge is power"

name: Galileo
title: Mathematician and astronomer
note: Discovered Jupiter's moons. Heliocentrism. Tried by the Church

name: Descartes
title: Philosopher and mathematician
note: "I think, therefore I am". Analytic geometry

name: Isaac Barrow
title: Mathematician and theologian
note: Teacher of Newton. Professor at Cambridge

name: Spinoza
title: Philosopher
note: Pantheism. "God is Nature". Earned a living grinding lenses

name: Locke
title: Philosopher and statesman
note: Father of liberalism. Social contract. Influenced American independence

name: Newton
title: Professor at Cambridge
note: Universal gravitation, laws of motion. Calculus

name: Leibniz
title: Philosopher and mathematician
note: Independently discovered calculus with Newton

name: Voltaire
title: Philosopher and writer
note: Standard-bearer of the Enlightenment. Religious tolerance

name: Francis Hutcheson
title: Philosopher
note: Teacher of Adam Smith. Professor at Glasgow

name: Benjamin Franklin
title: Statesman and scientist
note: Kite experiment. Drafted the Declaration. Representative of America

name: Rousseau
title: Philosopher and writer
note: Social contract. "Man is born free"

name: Adam Smith
title: Philosopher and economist
note: Father of economics. "Invisible hand". Laissez-faire

name: Kant
title: Professor at Königsberg
note: Critical philosophy. "Sapere aude"

name: Fichte
title: Philosopher
note: Continued Kant's critique. Theory of the self

name: Hegel
title: Professor at Berlin
note: Dialectics. Phenomenology of Spirit. Classmate of Schelling

name: Schopenhauer
title: Philosopher
works: The World as Will and Representation
note: Pessimistic philosophy. Moved beyond Kant's influence

name: John Stuart Mill
title: Philosopher and economist
note: On Liberty. Women's emancipation. Home-educated by his father

name: Darwin
title: Naturalist
note: Evolution by natural selection. Voyage of the Beagle

name: Marx
title: Thinker and revolutionary
note: From the Young Hegelians to historical materialism. Father of communism

name: Alfred Marshall
title: Economist
note: Teacher of Keynes. Cambridge school

name: Nietzsche
title: Philosopher
note: "God is dead". Overman. Follower of Schopenhauer

name: Freud
title: Psychiatrist
note: Founded psychoanalysis. Discovery of the unconscious

name: Husserl
title: Philosopher
note: Founded phenomenology. Teacher of Heidegger

name: Russell
title: Philosopher and mathematician
note: Symbolic logic. Nobel Prize in Literature. Teacher of Wittgenstein

name: Jung
title: Psychiatrist
note: Broke with Freud. Founded analytical psychology

name: Einstein
title: Physicist
note: Theory of relativity. Nobel Prize in Physics. E=mc²

name: Keynes
title: Economist
works: The General Theory of Employment, Interest and Money
note: Keynesian economics. Bretton Woods system

name: Wittgenstein
title: Philosopher
note: "Whereof one cannot speak, thereof one must be silent"

name: Heidegger
title: Philosopher
note: Being and Time. Source of existentialism

name: Popper
title: Philosopher
works: The Open Society and Its Enemies
note: Falsificationism. Defender of the open society

name: Sartre
title: Philosopher and writer
note: Existence precedes essence. Declined the Nobel Prize

name: Rawls
title: Philosopher
note: A Theory of Justice. "Veil of ignorance". Benchmark of modern political philosophy
